title: Ayan's PvP Overlay
description: The ultimate vanilla-vibe PvP overlay packed with all the essentials like short swords and low fire. Sharpen your combat visuals while keeping that classic Minecraft look and feel.
body:
Ayan PvP Overlay
Upgrade your combat experience with Ayan PvP Overlay, the definitive modern texture pack designed specifically for 1.9+ mechanical PvP. This overlay blends seamlessly with Minecraft’s default aesthetic, keeping that classic vanilla vibe while giving you the cutting-edge visual clarity needed for intense modern duels.
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da209d34b4d200ccc44a6c33da592d5e60463153.png)

Key Features:
Modern 1.9+ Optimization: Tailored perfectly for shield-and-axe or crystal PvP, featuring optimized weapon sizes and clean visual cues that match the timing of modern combat mechanics.

Essential PvP Tweaks: Packed with all the must-haves—short swords for maximum screen real estate, low fire to prevent vision block, and a sleek, transparent UI.

Default Look & Feel: Enhances your game without totally altering the blocks, ensuring you keep that nostalgic, un-modded Minecraft feel.

Pro Tip: Because this is an overlay, you can stack it right on top of your favorite default or faithful pack to create the ultimate vanilla-style competitive setup.
